The Warriors flipped the game in HISTORIC fashion! After the Lakers won the first quarter 38-15, Golden State fell behind by 25 points with 11:15 left in the second. The Warriors then stormed back, outscoring Los Angeles 38-15 in the second quarter to reach halftime tied at 53! It marked the first time in the shot-clock era (since 1954-55) that a team trailed by at least 23 points after the first quarter and recovered to tie or take the lead by halftime.
